clips.title: The story
paras: At Larson Clothiers, Thurman's Sewing Kit is needed for his tailoring work. The tools belong to young apprentice Thurman Schneider, who left them behind at his family's canal home to avoid a long day of stitching.

Thurman's Sewing Kit holds the everyday tools of an apprentice tailor: needles, shears, and thread. Young Thurman Schneider studies tailoring at Larson Clothiers, deep in Stormwind's Mage Quarter near the Mage Tower. His mother, Rema Schneider, knows he cannot do his work without the kit, so she asks passersby along the Canals to carry it to the shop. When Thurman gets the tools, his reaction shows he left them behind on purpose, hoping to trade a day of stitching garments for leisure.
